description: Fetch a patent from Google Patents (server-rendered bibliography — no browser, no API key) and extract a verified, hash-pinned patent-record (title/abstract/inventors/dates/CPC/claims/citations + content_sha). Deterministic: given the page bytes the record is a pure function (offline path replays a recorded page; live path fetches patents.google.com, the only host the cage permits). corpus 'Google Patents' is what coverage-report attests.
